_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson pitfalls 0, 3 and 4 — one fixture because all three are the same observation from three angles and share one compiled Integrands module. Measured on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, 2026-08-06: `import dolfinx`, `from dolfinx.fem import dirichletbc`, `from dolfinx.fem import functionspace` and `from dolfinx.io import XDMFFile, VTXWriter` all raise ModuleNotFoundError in the DUNE env; lagrange(gridView, ('Lagrange', 1)) raises TypeError; dune.ufl.DirichletBC(space, 0, dofs, extra) raises TypeError while DirichletBC(space, 0) works; dune.grid has no XDMFFile / VTXWriter / VTKFile attribute and gridView.writeVTK wrote dolfinx_probe.vtu. The PORTABILITY half of poisson#0 is asserted inside the fixture by building the weak form from ufl types only (checked: type(obj).__module__ starts with 'ufl' for the trial and test functions and both forms) and solving it. The dolfinx counterpart was confirmed out of band in ~/miniconda3/envs/fenics (dolfinx 0.10.0, ufl 2025.2.1): the byte-identical form dot(grad(u), grad(v))*dx == 1.0*v*dx passed dolfinx.fem.form(), while the space there is fem.functionspace(domain, ('Lagrange', 1)) and the BC is fem.dirichletbc(value, dofs, V) — a different call in both cases. That cross-check is NOT part of expect_in_output, because a fixture must not fail on a host that has no FEniCSx. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 installs XDMFFile and VTXWriter attributes on dune.grid, i.e. the world in which dune-fem has grown the dolfinx IO names. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'dune_grid_has_XDMFFile=False', 'dune_grid_has_VTXWriter=False', 'dune_dolfinx_api_divergence_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
